summary_en: 4,720,438 shares (20.03% of ex-treasury S/O) to be acquired from Nippon Steel via open-market bid (ToSTNeT-3), conditional on Nippon Steel's successful acquisition of 50.01% stake and board approval. Execution to commence early January 2027 following settlement of Nippon Steel's parallel public tender, targeting 100% delisting with post-transaction ownership: Nippon Steel 83.33%, Japan Lines 16.67%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Plans for Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Self-Tender Offer for Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
NS United Kaiun (Ticker: 9110) announced on 31 July 2026 a planned treasury stock acquisition via public tender offer (ToSTNeT-3) as part of a two-stage transaction initiated by Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal Corporation (NSSMC).

The company's board resolved to acquire 4,720,438 shares (20.03% of ex-treasury shares outstanding, based on 23,565,487 shares as of 30 June 2026) from NSSMC, which currently owns 7,861,280 shares (33.36% of outstanding). This tender is expressly conditional on completion of NSSMC's parallel public offer to acquire all remaining NS United shares (excluding treasury and those held by NSSMC itself and co-bidder Japan Lines), targeted to complete in early January 2027. The treasury tender is expected to commence the business day following NSSMC settlement, anticipated early January 2027.

Post-transaction, NS United will be delisted and held 83.33% by NSSMC and 16.67% by Japan Lines (NSSMC's wholly owned subsidiary). The rationale emphasizes maintaining the equity-method accounting treatment of NS United within NSSMC's consolidated statements, preserving operational and governance collaboration in dry-bulk shipping logistics, and management continuity via seconded officers. No price ceiling or aggregate yen limit is disclosed; execution is contingent on all stated conditions being satisfied or waived by NSSMC, including regulatory clearance and absence of material adverse changes.
